title: Mio reference, clean and high res
caption: Your char-face-1 pick (mio-front-d60) at 3072x3072, with no floor shadow, no hoodie drawstrings and no glasses. One change per step; pose, hair, face shape and colours are kept. The full PNGs, every attempt and the scripts are in art/parts/style-concepts/mio-ref-clean/.

images.caption: Every attempt in order. Top row: original, each step, final, cut-out. Middle row: the drawstrings attempts (03a and 03b redrew dark strings). Bottom row: the glasses attempts (04a kept square glasses, 04b changed the eye colour).

sections.title: Final
sections.caption: 3072x3072, plain pale grey background, and a transparent cut-out.
